description: Approved reusable layout patterns. Samples are fictional design specimens, not source-code claims.

patterns.title: Request lifecycle
patterns.whenToUse: HTTP/controller/service/repository paths verified by the selected source file
patterns.quality: Trace direction and real interfaces; preserve relative layer ordering

patterns.title: Sequence interaction
patterns.whenToUse: Order-sensitive method calls, request/reply timing or async callbacks
patterns.quality: Distinct lifelines, numbered messages and aligned arrows

patterns.title: State transitions
patterns.whenToUse: Finite states, approval workflow, lifecycle flags or real transitions
patterns.quality: Named states, source-grounded event triggers and labeled transitions

patterns.title: Data relationships
patterns.whenToUse: JPA entity relations, database keys, ownership and constraints
patterns.quality: Show correct cardinality and distinguish primary and foreign keys

patterns.title: Validation decision
patterns.whenToUse: Guard clauses, form validation, branching and error outcomes
patterns.quality: Unambiguous yes/no paths and explicit error or continuation result

patterns.title: Interface behavior
patterns.whenToUse: Visible frontend changes, form states, navigation or accessibility behavior
patterns.quality: Focused true before/after; never fabricate frontend for backend-only changes
